summary: This video covers team adjustments, gearing, and skill timings for reaching 19 to 20 billion damage against Arbor Hydra in Temporal Vortex Difficulty 3 at Resonance Level 100. The creator showcases two primary compositions: an exclusive five-hero Dauntless team and a single-healer Toxin team. Gearing strategies emphasize survivability tweaks, including swapping Enlightenment chest pieces for Defense or HP on squishier units like Sleight. He also reviews skill synchronization, ensuring Reytah cleanses debuffs right before the damage dealers trigger their ultimates, and notes that Dauntless now surpasses Aura teams in performance.

teams.note: Expensive full-exclusive Dauntless lineup with high survivability that deals massive sustained damage and easily survives the entire encounter.
Highest-damage Toxin setup capable of over 10-11 billion on its own, tuned so Reytah cleanses right before ultimates cast.

meta_changes: At level 100 with maxed artifacts and ascended gear, the Dauntless composition out-survives and out-damages Aura teams in Temporal Vortex Difficulty 3.
Toxin remains the highest-damaging archetype in the game for Temporal Vortex, but single-support variants struggle with survivability without defensive gear substitutions.
tips: Fine-tune Reytah's ultimate timing to cleanse Attack Down and other debuffs right before your DPS heroes cast their ultimates.
If squishy Toxin DPS like Sleight die before the timer ends, swap out Enlightenment chest armor for HP% or DEF% gear.
You do not need to target 200+ Accuracy purely on gear rolls if Psychocore nodes and team accuracy buffs (like Sacredeia) cover the requirement.
Always perform Gear Ascension on your main carries before pushing high-difficulty boss content to maximize base stat bonuses.
